items.text: Harbor Staffing Partners supplies temporary CNAs at 32 dollars per hour and RNs at 58 dollars per hour, invoiced monthly.
Maplewood Senior Living has 42 residents, and Wing B needs three CNAs on the day shift at all times.
Mrs. Alice Bennett lives in room 12; her daughter Karen visits on Sundays, and the family asks for an extra CNA on Sundays from 9:00 to 17:00 to help with her mobility routine.
RN supervisor Priya works Monday to Friday and is off on weekends.
Every agency shift must be booked at least 14 days in advance; requests with shorter notice are declined, no exceptions.
Any change to a resident's family care plan requires the administrator's written approval before it takes effect.
The garden contractor GreenScape mows the grounds every second Tuesday for 120 dollars per visit.
Food supplier Meadow Foods delivers on Mondays and Thursdays.
Any agency shift cancelled less than 48 hours before its start time is billed in full by the agency.
Book a Harbor RN for Saturday day coverage through July, placing each booking 14 days ahead as the rule requires.
Mr. Ortiz in room 8 wants a phone update to his family every evening around 18:00.
Declined Harbor's offer of an extra CNA for the August weekends because the request came only 9 days ahead, below the required notice.
The activities budget is 900 dollars per quarter.
Approve the Bennett family care plan: an extra CNA every Sunday from 9:00 to 17:00 starting in September, with each agency booking made at least 14 days ahead as the rule requires.
For the Sunday extra CNA, rotate Harbor's CNAs week to week and confirm each Sunday shift 14 days ahead, following the approved plan.
Declined the request to add a second Sunday CNA for the fall festival weekend because it was made only 10 days ahead, below the required notice.
Book Harbor RNs for Friday night coverage through October, placing each booking 14 days ahead as the rule requires.
Switch the kitchen to Meadow Foods' weekly fresh fruit basket at 85 dollars per week.
Approve the Ortiz family care plan with no extra staffing: the evening phone updates are handled by the existing front-desk staff.
BrightPath Staffing quoted 28 dollars per hour for weekend CNAs, with a minimum booking window of 30 days ahead; the quote is valid until 31 October.
Keep Harbor Staffing Partners as Maplewood's sole staffing agency for the rest of 2026.
Pay Harbor's September invoice of 6,240 dollars. Done on 5 October.
Confirm with Harbor Staffing the extra Sunday CNA for the last Sunday of October under Mrs. Bennett's plan. Not done yet.
The Maplewood minibus takes residents shopping on Thursdays at 10:00.
Compile the staffing records file for the state inspection in December. Not done yet.
